assertions.text: A scheduled dolt-backup.service run that starts while a prior run's sync is still in progress does not start a second sync of the same tenant, and records the skipped cycle in its telemetry.
steps: At 23:50:10Z start a manual oversized run so it holds the per-tenant lock across the next scheduled run: sudo -n systemd-run --unit=dolt-backup-overlap-proof-2 --uid=dolt --gid=dolt -p WorkingDirectory=/data/projects/dolt-server -p EnvironmentFile=/data/projects/dolt-server/backup.env -p EnvironmentFile=-/etc/doltdb/backup-creds.env.local -p EnvironmentFile=-/etc/doltdb/alert.env.local -p EnvironmentFile=-/etc/doltdb/backup-aws.env.local /data/projects/dolt-server/scripts/backup-sync.sh --db livespec-orch-beads-fabro
Read the scheduled run's journal: sudo -n journalctl -u dolt-backup.service --since '2026-11-05 01:00' --no-pager
